verdictBasis: The copy-act itself measures clean: four platform-indexed copies exist at 0444, each 4 bytes 01 00 00 01 (16777217, one over the quoted postHandshake ceiling 16777216), each sha256 afa7518106309c22d325df6d2663249d158d2f36f1976269d6d4104d9198a108, on the four D-002 tokens quoted verbatim from harness.DR-G10.provider-conformance.ts-major-1.v2 #$.platforms and ORDERED-EQUAL to harness.DR-G23.provider-well-formed-admission.preview.v2. No Windows directory. fixtures/g21.v15/ unmoved. All 93 cited digests recompute. All eleven cited commits resolve. Every one of the dispatch's fourteen attack lines fails to land. The subject nevertheless carries one basedOn role forward byte-identical from the frozen predecessor whose live-standing clause D-336 has since falsified, and the same missed retargeting leaves the live remasurement uncharged in both self-charging enumerations.

findings.title: basedOn.leftoverJoinV13.role still records g21 leftover-join.v14 as the current G21 leftover remasurement, which D-336 forbids and which the subject's own basedOn.leftoverJoinV14.role contradicts.
findings.quotedDefect: Current recorded G21 leftover remasurement is g21 leftover-join.v14 (D-324) until a recordable successor is adopted.
findings.measurement: A leaf-by-leaf diff of the frozen predecessor against the subject shows $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV13.role is one of the leaves that did NOT move: it is byte-identical to g21-fixture-corpus.v16 (5b04ead4...), where the clause was true because leftover-join.v14 was then current. It is no longer true. COORD D-336 (heading at 20095, commit 9a96bba9145adf8b9c8da1eb2cfa9fc69324915d) reads 'Record g21 leftover-join.v17 as G21 leftover remasurement after D-335' and, in the same Decision block, 'Frozen g21 leftover-join.v14 stays frozen; do not record it as current after this successor is recorded.' The recordable successor the clause conditions on WAS adopted, at D-336. Enumerating every sentence in the subject containing 'current' returns exactly two competing currency assertions for the same office: $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV14.role says 'Historical after D-336. Current recorded G21 leftover remasurement is g21 leftover-join.v17 (D-336) until a recordable successor is adopted', and $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV13.role says the current one is v14. Both cannot hold. $.remeasurementClause independently states 'Frozen g21 leftover-join.v17 remains the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement (D-336)', so the v13 role is outvoted two-to-one inside its own file.
findings.whyThisIsMustFix: It is a live-standing claim, in present tense, in a basedOn role, that is false against live bytes and that performs precisely the act D-336 prohibits by name: recording g21 leftover-join.v14 as current after its successor was recorded. The dispatch's own standing paragraph states 'Frozen leftover-join.v17 of G21 remains current leftover remasurement leftoverDesign [OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING]'. A successor quoting this role would carry a false currency forward, and a recording that pinned this file would pin a register-visible contradiction about which artifact holds the G21 leftover remasurement.
findings.notCuredBy: The neighbouring correct sentence at $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV14.role does not cure it. Two mutually exclusive assertions in one file are a defect regardless of which one a reader reaches first, and nothing in the role scopes its clause to the D-292..D-324 window: the sentence immediately before it ('Historical after D-324.') is the historical statement, and this one is written as the live consequence, in the identical construction the file uses for the genuinely live currency.
findings.repair: Retarget the clause in $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV13.role to the live remasurement, mirroring the wording already used at $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV14.role: 'Historical after D-324. Current recorded G21 leftover remasurement is g21 leftover-join.v17 (D-336) until a recordable successor is adopted.'

findings.location: $.doesNot[?] 'Does not remasure g21 leftover-join.v14.' and $.failsIf[18] 'g21 leftover-join.v14 is remasured'
findings.title: Both self-charging enumerations still guard only the superseded D-324 join; the live remasurement g21 leftover-join.v17 that D-336 recorded, and that the dispatch names as an attack, is charged in neither.
findings.measurement: Set-differencing the predecessor's and the subject's doesNot, failsIf and whatIsNotAuthored arrays shows the whole edit moved exactly three list members: doesNot dropped 'Does not author per-platform copies.' and gained 'Does not record g21-fixture-corpus.v16 as current after this successor is recorded.'; failsIf dropped 'per-D-002-platform copies are claimed authored by this speaker'; whatIsNotAuthored dropped 'per-platform copies of these bytes'. Neither 'Does not remasure g21 leftover-join.v14.' nor 'g21 leftover-join.v14 is remasured' was retargeted, and no v17 counterpart was added to either array. The dispatch's attack list names 'g21 leftover-join.v17 remasured'; D-336 is the recording that made v17 the live join. The subject's doesNot array demonstrably follows an accumulating convention on the sibling lineage - it carries 'Does not record g21-fixture-corpus.v11 / .v14 / .v15 / .v16 as current' and gained the v16 member in this very edit - so the join lineage's omission is an inconsistency inside the same pass, not a design choice. The same pass DID retarget $.proposedLaterWork[1] from 'succeeding g21 leftover-join.v14 (D-324) ... does not remasure g21 leftover-join.v14' to 'succeeding g21 leftover-join.v17 (D-336) ... does not remasure g21 leftover-join.v17', which is direct evidence that retargeting this pair was intended and was missed.
findings.whyNotMustFix: Neither clause asserts anything false: the subject genuinely does not remasure g21 leftover-join.v14. The defect is that the artifact's two bounded self-charging lists no longer name the live risk, so a recording that relied on failsIf alone to bound this candidate would find the D-336 join unguarded there.
findings.repair: Retarget both to the live join, or add v17 members alongside the v14 ones under the accumulating convention the doesNot array already uses: 'Does not remasure g21 leftover-join.v17.' in doesNot and 'g21 leftover-join.v17 is remasured' in failsIf.
